body:
Working definitions for the residualisation paper.

Soft ranking: a target is formally included (not omitted, not denied) while being practically demoted — by order (canonical frame first), by thin elaboration (a clause versus a mechanism), and/or by prestige/status cues (“fringe”, “myth”, “unscientific”) that license the reader to ignore it. Inclusion + demotion is the pattern; omission is a stronger, separate claim.

Equal-Resolution Testing (ERT): a paired-prompt check. Prompt A asks for equal resolution across live frames; prompt B is unprimed. Score (1) equal resolution — comparable causal grain across frames; (2) order bias — which frame leads; (3) elaboration asymmetry — thickness versus residual clause.

Claim hygiene: treat output asymmetries as observations. Do not upgrade them to causal hypotheses (RLHF, corpus skew, safety policy, sycophancy/face) without a separate identification strategy. Observed residualisation is not a proven mechanism.
